data.name: Ragnarok X: Next Generation
data.detailed_description:
Gravity's Ragnarok X : Next Generation Redefine RO Classic Adventure - Over 20 Million Players Worldwide

ROX is the official next-gen evolution of the classic Ragnarok Online MMORPG. With enhanced visuals, strategic combat, and diverse gameplay, ROX stays true to its roots while offering Fair Loot, Free Trading, and True Adventures. Your legend begins now— Are you ready?

◈ A Classic Reborn: Fair and Free ◈

ROX honors the original *Ragnarok Online*'s story, world, and job system while upgrading everything else: a more immersive world, better controls, modern graphics, and seamless mobile-to-cross play. Built for both veterans and newcomers, ROX is the future of classic MMORPGs.

◈ A Real Player-Driven Economy ◈

Just earn, trade, and thrive. In ROX, powerful gear comes from fair boss drops and player-to-player trading. Predict market trends, master the auction house, and compete with thousands of players in one shared economy. This is Trade-to-Win, not Cash-to-Win.

◈ A Living World of Adventures and Battles ◈

Embark on solo quests, challenge dungeons, or team up for massive multiplayer events.

Explore diverse zones filled with epic storylines and real challenges. Join a guild, make lifelong friends, and experience a warm, social MMO community. From PvE raids to PvP arenas and GvG wars — Midgard is alive, and waiting.

◈ Deep Job & Gear Customization ◈

ROX features a rich class system rooted in deep lore — including newly introduced 3rd-tier jobs. Combine gear, skills, and strategies to create your own unique hero. Victory comes from smart builds and skilled play. Teamwork and class synergy are the keys to mastering battle.

◈ Life Skills, Crafting, and In-Game Prosperity ◈

Fish, garden, cook, mine, raise pets, and profit. ROX features a full life skill and crafting system where everything you produce—potions, food, gear—can be sold to other players. Build your in-game livelihood and even earn while playing.

◈ Iconic Monsters Return, Nostalgia Rekindled ◈

Step back into a world filled with familiar faces and unforgettable foes. From the charming Poring and mischievous **Golden Thief Bug**, to legendary bosses like **Osiris**, **Lord of Death**, and **Baphomet**—ROX brings the heart of Ragnarok Online back in full force.

◈ Cross-Platform Play for Unmatched Flexibility ◈

One of ROX's standout features is its seamless cross-platform play. Whether you're on mobile or PC, your progress is saved across all devices, allowing you to continue your adventure wherever you are.

Begin your next-gen RO adventure now！Craft your legend and create your own path in Midgard!

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ​​NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti with 2GB GDDR5 memory or higher​
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
